title.zh: 宣布南伊罗戈省 Suyo 市镇的 Kimpusa 村为该市镇镇中心与市政府所在地的法案
title.en: An Act to Declare Barrio Kimpusa of the Municipality of Suyo, Province of Ilocos Sur, as the Poblacion and the Seat of the Municipal Government of the Said Municipality
title.orig: An Act to Declare Barrio Kimpusa of the Municipality of Suyo, Province of Ilocos Sur, as the Poblacion and the Seat of the Municipal Government of the Said Municipality

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1965/ra_4427_1965.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Barrio Kimpusa of the Municipality of Suyo, Province of Ilocos Sur, is hereby declared as the poblacion and the seat of the municipal government of the said municipality.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
